translation_notes: The query's STRUCTURE, not merely a term, is built by string concatenation: `"""ASK {""" + triple + """ }"""` where `triple` is an arbitrary caller-supplied fragment of Turtle syntax (a full `s p o` clause, sometimes several), spliced directly into the query body. `s{ }` only exposes interpolation in TERM position (`{expr}` inside a written pattern), never as a hole for an entire graph pattern or clause; there is no island form that takes a pattern as a run-time string. Kept as plain rdflib (`g.query(...)`) in translated.ldpy, unchanged from original.py -- forcing this into `s{ }` would require treating `triple` as literal query text, i.e. exactly the textual substitution the language's `s{ }` interpolation is designed to rule out.
